contentHeader.name: MixTank_MT01
contentHeader.author: j.berger
contentHeader.Comment: Mixing tank MT01, CPU 1214C DC/DC/DC (6ES7214-1AG40-0XB0, firmware V4.6) with SM 1231 AI4 (6ES7231-4HD32-0XB0).

documentation.xhtml:p: Wire break or out of range
Scale a 4-20 mA analog input word to engineering units with wire-break detection.
Step: batch complete, wait for acknowledge
Alarm: level transmitter wire break / out of range
Alarm: temperature transmitter wire break / out of range
Alarm: agitator commanded but no running feedback
Alarm: filling took longer than 10 min
Minimum level for agitator and heater, %
Stop pushbutton S2 (NC, TRUE = not pressed)
Agitator contactor K3 auxiliary contact (running feedback)
Agitator motor protector Q3 not tripped
High-high level switch LSHH101 (NC, TRUE = level not high-high)
Outlet valve XV103 closed limit switch
Heater safety thermostat TSH102 OK (not over-temperature)
Level transmitter LT101, 4-20 mA = 0-100 % (SM 1231 ch0, raw 0..27648)
Temperature transmitter TT101, 4-20 mA = 0-150 degC (SM 1231 ch1, raw 0..27648)

content.xhtml:p: Scale temperature transmitter TT101 (4-20 mA -> 0-150 degC)
Level above minimum for agitator and heater
Acknowledge alarms (conditions still present set again)
Stop or fault: abort batch, back to idle
Idle -> Fill A: start with outlet closed and lid closed
Fill A -> Fill B at level setpoint A
Fill B -> Heat at level setpoint B
Agitator: heat and mix steps, overload OK, lid closed, level above minimum
Heater: heat and mix steps, agitator running, level above minimum, thermostat OK, below setpoint
